title: Derived-homology affine Tor coordinates respect all certified restrictions
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a closed immersion, n≥0, B=i_*O_Z, and Q=i^*H^{-n}(B[0]⊗^L B[0]) for the fixed derived tensor. For an affine U let T_U be tilde over Γ(Y,U), transported to U and then pushed to Y and tensor-pulled to Z; let M_U=Tor_n^{Γ(Y,U)}(Γ(Y,U)/I_U,Γ(Y,U)/I_U), where I_U is the closed-immersion ideal. There is a family t_U:T_U(M_U)|_{i^{-1}U}≅Q|_{i^{-1}U}. For each affine principal inclusion V⊆U there is q:M_U→M_V certified by [new-t2-self-tor-restriction-certificate] over the structure-sheaf restriction ring homomorphism, such that t_U applied to the restriction of selfTorAffineSection_U(x) equals t_V applied to selfTorAffineSection_V(q(x)) for every x∈M_U [new-t2-self-tor-affine-section]. The exterior comparison and ideal-section tuples do not occur.

proof.text: Use exists_selfTor_chosen_resolution_charts to obtain t and, on each principal affine inclusion, an explicit quotient map ψ, augmented comparison a and tensor comparison k for the fixed projective quotient resolutions, together with the section equality for the explicitly constructed homology map q.

Construct q from H_n(k) using exact restriction-of-scalars homology and the canonical Tor computation isomorphisms. The proved helpers restrict_homologyπ and tensorComparison_cycle_formula establish its cycle formula by naturality, cancellation of the Tor isomorphisms and injectivity of iCycles. Apply selfTor_restriction_certificate_of_resolution to upgrade this formula to the certificate for every pair of resolutions. Pair the certificate with the unchanged section equation for the same t and q.
